sources.title: Giga-Embeddings-instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Giga-Embeddings-instruct is an instruction-tuned text embedding model built on the GigaChat-3b decoder-only LLM by ai-sage. The model produces 2048-dimensional embeddings using latent-attention pooling and handles sequences up to 4096 tokens. It was pretrained on GigaChat and further trained on a mixture of English and Russian data, making it specifically suited for bilingual ...
